reels.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses the core scalability problem of modern LLMs, which is high-interest for tech-savvy viewers. It offers a perfect visual hook: a 'traffic controller' metaphor for tokens.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI could decide which brain to use for every single word it writes?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A traffic router at a highway interchange directing tiny cars (tokens) to different speed-lanes based on their complexity.
